::: {.bs-editorial-lead}
Research is where Technology Commons documents questions that need more than a lesson page.
:::

This section will collect classroom experiments, technical investigations, project notes, and reflections on technology education.

Topics may include engineering design, project-based learning, computing, fabrication, transportation technology, assessment, open educational resources, and the NICE design process.

The aim is to make useful work inspectable: describe the question, show the method, record the evidence, and leave enough detail for someone else to learn from or repeat the work.
:::
:::
